output.brief: The regression is most likely caused by the 2 Nov storage-node compaction tuning push (FC-7710), not the gateway 5.8 release. In every cell, GET p99 jumped within minutes of the config push, and disk utilisation rose to about 97% with node-side GET service time up roughly fourfold. The clearest control is cell aps-3: it received 5.8 at 01:05 without the config push and its latency stayed at about 94 ms. A rollback of euw-1 on 6 Nov also changed nothing. Network and traffic growth don't explain it. I'm fairly confident about ruling out the gateway release and network; I'm moderately confident about the compaction link, since no one has yet reversed the change and checked. Do not roll back 5.7 fleet-wide: it would not fix latency and would reopen the SEC-2291 security exposure. Do not pause compaction, since that would let backlog grow toward disk-full. Next: revert FC-7710 in one cell, watch GET p99 and backlog, then extend. Attribution of the backlog to Orrin versus the lifecycle sweep is still pending (10 Nov), so hold the Orrin rate-limit decision until then.
